q: What carbon data should a buyer ask a Map Ta Phut polymer supplier for?
title: Map Ta Phut polymers: supplier data
short: Ask for a cradle to gate footprint per tonne of the exact grade, with feedstock, cracker and polymerisation energy, the allocation method and the year. Thailand runs a national carbon footprint label for products, so some suppliers already hold a figure. Multiply it by the tonnes on your invoices in Scope 3 Category 1.
audience: Packaging, auto parts and appliance makers buying polyethylene, polypropylene and PVC from Map Ta Phut

p: Crackers fed with ethane from Gulf of Thailand gas and those fed with naphtha produce different figures. Ask which feed the grade came from.
A national product label shows a figure was calculated and reviewed under its scheme. Check its year and boundary before using it.
Use a published resin average and label it as secondary data.

senseible: Senseible reads purchase invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so each supplier figure in your Scope 3 sits next to the quantity and the document it applies to.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
